description: Keep one picture of a ready drawing as a new presenter of the team's, by the id describe_presenter answered and the picture's number from get_described. Each call adds a presenter and replaces none. Keeping removes the drawing, so only one picture of it can be kept; a drawing not ready, a picture it does not have and a drawing already kept answer not_found. Answers presenter, with its id, name and voice: the id goes in presenters of write_scripts, quote_video and make_video, and list_presenters lists it. Left out, voice is the one the description said, or none until set_presenter_voice sets it. Free.

picture.description: The number of the picture to keep.

voice.description: A woman's voice or a man's voice, for an Arabic video whose voice is added after filming: the person's choice, which a picture does not tell.

name: keep_presenter
title: Keep a presenter
